summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney in src/money.ts and makes it format through Intl.NumberFormat with a currency argument. invoiceLines now passes a currency that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed export still imported by cart.ts
findings.problem: The change renames formatPrice to formatMoney and leaves no formatPrice export behind. src/cart.ts line 1 still imports formatPrice, and src/cart.ts line 8 still calls it.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript compiler rejects cart.ts, so the build fails. A bundler without type checks would ship a cart total that throws at runtime.
findings.fix: Update src/cart.ts to call formatMoney with a currency. Another option is to keep formatPrice as a wrapper that calls formatMoney with USD.

findings.title: Changed formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: formatMoney now adds thousands separators and accepts any currency code. The repository has no test that covers formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: Nothing checks the new output format or what happens with an invalid currency code. A regression in invoice text would go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines. Cover large amounts, a non-USD currency and an invalid currency code.
